record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: Classify all irreducible components of Hilb_d(A^n) for reasonably small degree d, for example d = 10 or a little higher, with arbitrary ambient dimension n.

evidence.quote: Problem VIII. Classify all components of Hilbd(A^n) for d reasonably small, for example d = 10 or a little higher, n arbitrary.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^n)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional closed subschemes of length $d$ in the affine space $\mathbb{A}^n_k$. Equivalently, its $k$-points are in bijection with ideals $I \subset k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ such that $\dim_k k[x_1,\dots,x_n]/I = d$.

For each pair $(d,n)$ with $d$ small (for instance $d = 10$, or somewhat larger) and $n$ an arbitrary positive integer, give a complete classification of the irreducible components of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^n)$. That is, enumerate the irreducible components, describe a general member of each component (e.g. via the local algebra structure of the corresponding zero-dimensional scheme), and determine their dimensions.
artifact.status_search_result: Complete classifications of irreducible components of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^n)$ are known only for small degrees: up to $d=8$ (with explicit lists, e.g. $\mathrm{Hilb}_8(\mathbb{A}^n)$ has two components for $n\geq 4$), and partial results exist for $d=9,10,11$. New elementary and irrational components have been discovered in recent years (e.g. irrational components for $n\geq 12$), but a full classification for $d=10$ with arbitrary $n$ remains open.

status_evidence.title: Elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points (Jelisiejew)
status_evidence.snippet: Hilb_8(A^d) has exactly two irreducible components for d ≥ 4; new elementary components are constructed in higher degrees.
status_evidence.claim: Classifications are known only up through small degrees, with the picture becoming complicated already at d around 8–11.

status_evidence.title: Irrational components of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: For each n ≥ 12 there exist irrational components of Hilb(A^n).
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to discover new components, indicating the classification problem in small degree and arbitrary n is still active and open.
